> **This repository is generated.** It is the `python/` directory of Tapline's
> monorepo, which is private, force-pushed here whenever that directory changes.
> Commits made directly on this repo are overwritten by the next sync.
>
> Pull requests are still welcome — we apply them upstream by hand with your
> authorship intact, and they land back here on the next sync under a new commit
> hash. Bug reports and feature requests belong in this repo's issue tracker.
